sn4.23:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Rājagahe viharati Veḷuvane kalandakanivāpe || || 2.
sn4.23:1.3: Tena kho pana samayena āyasmā Godhiko Isigili-passe viharati Kāḷasilāyaṃ || || 3.
sn4.23:1.4: Atha kho āyasmā Godhiko appamatto ātāpī pahitatto viharanto sāmādhikam ceto-vimuttiṃ phusi || ||
sn4.23:1.5: Atha kho āyasmā Godhiko tamhā sāmādhikāya ceto-vimuttiyā parihāyi || || 4.
sn4.23:1.6: Dutiyaṃ pi kho āyasmā Godhiko appamatto ātāpī pahitatto viharanto sāmādhikam
sn4.23:1.11: Dutiyam pi kho āyasmā tamhā sāmādhikāya ceto-vimuttiyā parihāyi || || 5. Tatiyaṃ pi kho āyasmā Godhiko appamatto || pe || parihāyi || || 6.
sn4.23:1.12: Catutthaṃ pi kho āyasmā Godhiko appamatto || pe || parihāyi || || 7. Pañcamaṃ pi kho āyasmā Godhiko || pe || parihāyi || || 8. Chaṭṭhaṃ pi kho āyasmā Godhiko appamatto ātāpī pahitatto viharanto sāmādhikaṃ ceto-vimuttiṃ phusi || ||
sn4.23:1.13: [Chaṭṭhaṃ pi kho āyasmā Godhiko tamhā samādhikāya ceto vimuttiya parihāyi || || 9.
sn4.23:1.14: Sattamaṃ pi kho āyasmā Godhiko appamatto ātāpī pahitatto viharanto
sn4.23:2.1: Atha kho āyasmato Godhikassa etad ahosi || ||
sn4.23:2.2: Yāva chaṭṭhaṃ khvāham sāmādhikāya ceto-vimuttiyā parihīno ||
sn4.23:2.4: Atha kho Māro pāpimā āyasmato Godhikassa cetasā cetoparivitakkam aññāya yena Bhagavā ten-upasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi || ||
sn4.23:6.1: Tena kho pana samayena āyasmatā Godhikena sattham āharitaṃ hoti || || 13.
sn4.23:6.2: Atha kho Bhagavā Māro pāpimā iti viditvā Māram pāpimantaṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi || ||
sn4.23:8.2: Āyāma bhikkhave yena Isigili-passaṃ Kāḷasilā ten-upasaṅkamissāma yattha Godhikena kulaputtena sattham āharitan ti || 15.
sn4.23:8.3: Evaṃ bhante ti kho te bhikkhū Bhagavato paccassosuṃ || || 16.
sn4.23:9.1: Atha kho Bhagavā sambahulehi bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ yena Isigili-passaṃ Kāḷasilā ten-upasaṅkami || ||
sn4.23:9.2: Addasā kho Bhagavā āyasmantam Godikaṃ dūrato va mañcake vivattakkhandhaṃ semānam || || 17.
sn4.23:9.3: Tena kho pana samayena dhumāyitattam timirayitattaṃ gacchat-eva purimaṃ disaṃ || gacchati pacchimaṃ disaṃ || gacchati uttaraṃ disaṃ || gacchati dakkhiṇaṃ disaṃ || gacchati uddhaṃ gacchati adho gacchati anudisaṃ || || 18.
sn4.23:10.2: Passatha no tumhe bhikkhave etaṃ dhumāyitattam timirāyitattaṃ || gacchat-eva purimaṃ dīsaṃ || gacchati pacchimaṃ || uttaraṃ || dakkhiṇaṃ || uddhaṃ || adho || gacchati anudisan ti || ||
sn4.23:10.4: Eso kho bhikkhave Māro pāpimā Godhikassa kulaputtassa viññāṇaṃ samanvesati ||
sn4.23:10.5: kattha Godhikassa kulaputtassa viññāṇaṃ patiṭṭhitan ti ||
sn4.23:10.6: appatiṭṭhitena ca bhikkhave viññāṇena Godhiko kulaputto parinibbuto ti || || 20.
sn4.23:10.7: Atha kho Māro pāpimā beluva-paṇḍuvīṇam ādāya yena Bhagavā ten-upasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā gāthāya ajjhabhāsi || ||
